FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

Louisiana fishing licence

Anglers aged 18 or older need fishing coverage. Saltwater anglers generally need both Basic Fishing and Saltwater licences; a guide's licence alone is not the client licence.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Anglers aged 18 or older who take or possess fish.

Who doesn’t

  • Children aged 17 or younger.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Non-resident Basic Fishing 5-daynon resident5 days$30 USD
Non-resident Basic Fishing annualnon resident1 year$68 USD
Charter Passenger Freshwaterany3 days on a qualifying guided trip$10 USD
Charter Passenger Saltwaterany3 days on a qualifying charter vessel$20 USD

Extra stamps and permits

  • Non-resident Saltwater 5-day licence · $30 USD
    Added to Basic Fishing for saltwater fishing outside an applicable charter-passenger arrangement.
  • Recreational Offshore Landing Permit · $0 USD
    Required for private anglers aged 18 or older who possess listed offshore species.

Saltwater

The Saltwater licence is normally an addition to Basic Fishing, not a replacement.

Fishing with a guide or charter

Clients need applicable standard licences or a charter-passenger licence. A captain's charter ROLP covers paid clients for that permit.

Rules visitors should know

  • The saltwater charter-passenger licence requires a licensed guide aboard.
  • Listed offshore species need ROLP coverage before possession in Louisiana waters.

How to buy

Use the LDWF online licence service or an authorised licence vendor.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Louisiana?

Anglers aged 18 or older need fishing coverage. Saltwater anglers generally need both Basic Fishing and Saltwater licences; a guide's licence alone is not the client licence.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Louisiana?

Non-resident Basic Fishing 5-day: $30 USD; Non-resident Basic Fishing annual: $68 USD; Charter Passenger Freshwater: $10 USD; Charter Passenger Saltwater: $20 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Louisiana?

Use the LDWF online licence service or an authorised licence vendor.
